description: Scrape US education job listings from TopSchoolJobs.org (Education Week): title, employer, location, salary and, on request, the full text, categories and apply link. Pay-per-event.
readme:
# TopSchoolJobs Scraper Scrape job listings from TopSchoolJobs ([topschooljobs.org](https://www.topschooljobs.org/)), the Education Week job board for US education jobs. You get the title, school or employer, location, salary text with parsed dollar amounts when the advertiser states them, and the New and Featured badges for every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full description, the exact posting and closing time, the employer page, categories, job types and the apply address. Search by keyword and the site's own filters (state, job category, school level, hours, employer type), sort by newest first, or start from any TopSchoolJobs jobs address. ## What you get - One row per job, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, in USD) when the salary text names amounts such as "$150,000 - $170,000", "Up to $90,000" or "Starting at $200,000". - Optional job page details: exact posting and closing time, full description as HTML and plain text, employer page, recruiter type, categories, job types, employment types and the apply address. These columns are filled only with the job page option on (detail-only columns). - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - A run with an input that has none of the fields below returns 5 jobs for the keyword teacher. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/topschooljobs-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `topschooljobs-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "teacher" (teacher jobs in the US). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "teacher" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as teacher, principal, school counselor or special education. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to read the newest jobs. | | `startUrls` | TopSchoolJobs addresses: `https://www.topschooljobs.org/jobs/` or `https://www.topschooljobs.org/jobs/texas/teaching/?Keywords=math`. Only the Keywords and sort=Date parameters are kept. A `/searchjobs/` address with only Keywords is read as `/jobs/?Keywords=...`; any other `/searchjobs/` address is skipped with a warning, because this actor reads only the `/jobs/` pages. Reading starts at page 1. Paths that the site's robots.txt disallows (`/invalid-request/`, `/analytics/`, `/apply-profile/`, emailjob and previewjob paths) are rejected with a message in the run status. | | `locations` | US state slugs: `arizona`, `colorado`, `florida`, `illinois`, `massachusetts`, `new-jersey`, `new-york`, `pennsylvania`, `texas`, `virginia`. Any other state works too, for example `ohio` or `north-carolina`. | | `jobCategories` | `administrator`, `teaching`, `support-staff`, `product-services-and-policy`. | | `schoolLevels` | `early-childhood`, `elementary-school`, `middle-school`, `high-school`, `college-university`. | | `jobTypes` | Hours: `full-time`, `part-time`, `temporary`. | | `employerTypes` | `catholic-school`, `charter-school`, `for-profit`, `government-state-doe`, `independent-private-school`, `non-profit`, `public-school-system`. | | `sortBy` | `relevance` (the site's default order) or `date` (newest first, the site's own `sort=Date` link). | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword or start URL. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. Each job with a fetched job page adds the job-detail event (see Pricing). | The filters are the path slugs of the site's browse list, for example `/jobs/texas/teaching/high-school/?Keywords=math`. The site lists only its top links per filter, so the fields take free text: a value is lower-cased, spaces and `&` become `-`, and only letters, digits and `-` are kept. The slugs above are the ones seen on the site; others may work. Every request uses this browse path (`/jobs/`, never `/searchjobs/`). Slugs the robots.txt disallows are skipped with one warning each and never requested. One search runs per keyword and per combination of one value from each filter you fill (at most 60 searches per run). When all values of a filter are skipped, the run reads nothing and ends with 0 jobs. Examples: ```json { "searchQueries": ["principal"], "locations": ["Texas"], "maxResults": 30 } ``` ```json { "jobCategories": ["teaching"], "schoolLevels": ["high-school"], "sortBy": "date" } ``` ## Sample output ```json { "id": "2490869", "title": "Mountain Views Supervisory Union Superintendent of Schools", "slug": "mountain-views-supervisory-union-superintendent-of-schools", "company": "Mountain Views Supervisory Union", "company_id": "d4b3de46-0f4e-406f-bcb8-2a9a7b5a5e18", "company_url": "https://www.topschooljobs.org/employer/d4b3de46-0f4e-406f-bcb8-2a9a7b5a5e18/mountain-views-supervisory-union", "company_logo": "https://www.topschooljobs.org/getasset/47d14219-f245-4e8a-8f9b-2e2760ea80f6/", "location": "Woodstock, Vermont", "city": "Woodstock", "region": "Vermont", "country_code": "US", "location_terms": [ "Windsor County", "Vermont", "United States", "North America", "Woodstock" ], "salary_text": "$150,000 - $170,000", "salary_min": 150000, "salary_max": 170000, "salary_currency": "USD", "description_short": "An invitation to apply: SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS Mt. Views Supervisory Union Woodstock, VT Visit our website at: MVSU Only completed online ap...", "description_html": "

An invitation to apply:

SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS

...", "description_text": "An invitation to apply:\n\nSUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS\n\nMt. Views Supervisory Union\n\nWoodstock, VT\n\n...", "date_posted": "2026-10-13T16:17:00.000Z", "valid_through": "2026-12-13T04:59:00.000Z", "is_new": false, "is_featured": true, "recruiter_id": "2487120", "recruiter_type": "Public School System", "application_method": "External", "apply_url": "https://mvsu.schoolspring.com/?jobid=5934976", "listing_type": "Admin Max", "direct_apply": false, "employment_types": [ "FULL_TIME" ], "categories": [ "Administrator", "Superintendent" ], "job_types": [ "Full-Time" ], "job_url": "https://www.topschooljobs.org/job/2490869/mountain-views-supervisory-union-superintendent-of-schools/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "teacher", "source": "topschooljobs.org", "scraped_at": "2026-11-11T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Numeric job id: the number in the job address /job///. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the listing. | | `slug` | string, null | Text part of the job address. | | `company` | string, null | Employer name as shown on the listing. | | `company_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Id of the employer page (the uuid in /employer//). | | `company_url` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employer profile page on TopSchoolJobs. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the employer. | | `location` | string, null | Location text as shown ('City, State'). | | `city` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). City from the job posting data. | | `region` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). State from the job posting data. | | `country_code` | string, null | Country code of the site, always US. | | `location_terms` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Location hierarchy terms of the job, from the county up to the continent. Empty when the page has none. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as typed by the advertiser, for example 'Competitive' or '$150,000 - $170,000'. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound in USD, read from the salary text when it states amounts ("$150,000 - $170,000", "Starting at $200,000"). Null otherwise. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound in USD, read from the salary text. "Up to X" gives only the maximum. Null otherwise. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | USD when the amounts were read, else null. | | `description_short` | string, null | Teaser text of the listing card. | | `description_html` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as HTML. | | `description_text` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as plain text. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Exact posting time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Closing time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `is_new` | boolean | True when the card carries the green 'New' badge (added in the last 2 days). | | `is_featured` | boolean | True when the card is a showcase (featured) listing. | | `recruiter_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Internal id of the recruiter or employer account, as given in the page data. | | `recruiter_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Type of employer, for example Public School System. | | `application_method` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). How applications are taken, for example Email or ExternalRedirect. | | `apply_url` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Address where the application is made, as given by the employer. Null when absent. | | `listing_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Listing product of the job, for example Admin Max. | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). directApply flag of the job posting data. | | `employment_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employment types from the job posting data (TEMPORARY, FULL_TIME, ...). Empty when none. | | `categories` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Job categories of the job page. Empty when none. | | `job_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Job type labels of the job page (Full-Time, Part-Time, Temporary). Empty when none. | | `job_url` | string | Job page on TopSchoolJobs. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword, start URL or 'all jobs' that found the job. | | `source` | string | Source host. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was built, ISO 8601 (UTC). | ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts, one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset, and, only with `includeDetails` on, one `job-detail` event for each job whose job page was fetched and read. A job whose job page could not be read is delivered with its list fields and charged only the `job-result` event. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). With details on, each job with a fetched detail page adds $0.005 (job-detail event). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [HigherEdJobs Scraper: Academic, Faculty & University Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/higheredjobs-scraper): Academic, faculty and university jobs. - [Tes.com UK Education Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/tes-uk-scraper): UK education jobs from Tes. - [Teaching Vacancies GOV UK Scraper (DfE)](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/teaching-vacancies-uk-scraper): Teaching jobs in England from the DfE service. - [WayUp Scraper: US Intern & Entry-Level Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/wayup-us-scraper): US internships and entry-level jobs from WayUp. ## FAQ **How many jobs can one search return?** A search or the job list shows 20 jobs per page. The actor reads page after page until the site's result count is reached, the last page is reached, or your limit is reached (at most 1000 jobs per search). **Is the posting date exact?** With `includeDetails` on, yes: `date_posted` and `valid_through` come from the job page. The list pages show no posting date, so those two columns are empty with details off. **Why is the salary parsed for only some jobs?** Advertisers type the salary freely, and most jobs show only "Competitive". Such texts are returned as `salary_text` only. The numbers `salary_min`, `salary_max` and `salary_currency` are filled when the text starts with a dollar amount or range. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged for jobs. **What if the site blocks a page?** The site is protected by a firewall. The actor loads every page through the Apify UNBLOCKER proxy group, which your Apify plan must include. A page that still comes back as a firewall page is retried twice on a new session and then skipped with a warning. If a job page cannot be read, the row is delivered with its list fields only, without the job-detail charge, and the run status says how many job pages were missed. If list pages cannot be read at all, the run ends with a clear "Blocked" status. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/topschooljobs-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
